faq.q: Which country has the most people?
faq.a: India, with about 1.45 billion people in 2024. It passed China in 2023, according to the United Nations.
asks: What is the most populated country?

faq.q: Did India pass China in population?
faq.a: Yes. The United Nations estimates India became the most populous country in 2023, as China's population began to shrink slowly.

faq.q: Why is Nigeria growing so fast?
faq.a: Nigeria has a very young population, and families there have more children on average than in most countries, so its population is rising quickly.
asks: How many people live in Nigeria?

faq.q: How many people live on Earth?
faq.a: About 8.2 billion people in 2024. The world passed 8 billion in November 2022.

faq.q: Which country has the fewest people?
faq.a: Vatican City, with only a few hundred residents.

facts: According to the UN, India overtook China as the world's most populous country in 2023.
Nigeria is the most populous country in Africa, with about 230 million people.
